restaurantName: Ban Ting Jia Yan (Suzhou Industrial Park)
address: 1F, Tonino Lamborghini Hotel, 168 Xinggang Street, Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou, China Mainland
bio: This restaurant on the shore of Jinji Lake affords stunning views. Live Pingtan and Kunqu performances are a nod to Suzhou culture, but the theatrics continue offstage: The fried sheefish with shrimp roe served in a metre-long plate is quite a spectacle. The flesh is tender and finely textured, in stark contrast with the thin, crispy scales. Fox nut sweet porridge or square cakes with red date filling make for a perfect sweet finale....
pageTitle: Ban Ting Jia Yan (Suzhou Industrial Park)
